summary: Delegated both zotero-resolve-sqlite-path.sh consumer sites to the shared resolver: literature-audit.sh's DEFAULT_SEARCH_PATHS third element now derives from ZOTERO_DATA_DIR=$(dirname $(zotero-resolve-sqlite-path.sh)) instead of a hardcoded $HOME/Zotero/storage, and zotero-setup.sh's _detect_data_dir() Step 3 now calls the resolver plus dirname instead of its own 3-candidate for-loop, with Steps 1/2 and the four call sites untouched. The cmd_detect stderr diagnostic was reworded to describe the delegated ladder truthfully. Verified live: a pre-patch baseline (Phase 1) showed zotero-setup.sh --detect diverging from the resolver (stale /home/benjamin/Zotero, which has no storage dir, vs. the resolver's live /home/benjamin/Documents/Zotero, which has 939 storage entries); post-patch (Phase 4), --detect, dirname(resolver), and the re-derived audit search path all agree on /home/benjamin/Documents/Zotero, and a live literature-audit.sh --xref run confirmed its 5 test PDFs actually came from the resolver-derived storage directory (the first two search paths contributed 0). All scope/safety checks passed: only the two intended scripts plus specs/904_.../  changed, no .claude/ paths written, the resolver itself is untouched, ~/Zotero and zotero-library.json were not touched, and no new task-number citation was introduced.
